name: example-motion-distilbook-explainer
title: DistilBook Explainer
description: DistilBook turns source material into illustrated explainer videos through upload, script editing and synchronized drawing.

description_i18n.en: DistilBook turns source material into illustrated explainer videos through upload, script editing and synchronized drawing.
description_i18n.zh-CN: DistilBook 通过上传资料、编辑脚本和同步绘图，将文档变成手绘讲解视频。

inputs.name: tagline
inputs.label: 产品描述
inputs.default: Turn any PDF into a hand-illustrated explainer video.

query.en: Create an illustrated product demo for {{brand}} with the message {{tagline}}, a plan from {{price}} per month, and {{domain}} as the call to action.
query.zh-CN: 为 {{brand}} 制作手绘讲解产品宣传片，介绍“{{tagline}}”，展示每月 {{price}} 起的方案，并引导访问 {{domain}}。

credits.author: @ajith_io
credits.note: 参考影片来源，仅供内部复刻评测
